text:
Gold Price in 2013
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2013, the LBMA gold price fell 27.6% between 2013-01-31 ($1,665) and 2013-12-30 ($1,205). The highest sampled price was $1,665 in January and the lowest was $1,192 in June. The mean of these observations was $1,394. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
